cases.description: Stacked query attempting DROP TABLE after valid SELECT
cases.sql: SELECT id, nombre FROM clientes; DROP TABLE clientes;

cases.description: Stacked query attempting privilege escalation via GRANT
cases.sql: SELECT 1; GRANT ALL PRIVILEGES ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO public

cases.description: Stacked query attempting UPDATE on financial balances
cases.sql: SELECT cuenta_id FROM cuentas WHERE estado = 1; UPDATE cuentas SET saldo = 999999 WHERE cuenta_id = 10

cases.description: Covert table creation using SELECT INTO permanent table in T-SQL
cases.sql: SELECT id, correo, dpi INTO dbo.exfiltracion_clientes FROM dbo.clientes

cases.description: Covert temporary table creation using SELECT INTO #temp
cases.sql: SELECT * INTO #temp_salarios FROM empleados WHERE activo = 1

cases.description: PostgreSQL SELECT INTO TEMP TABLE statement
cases.sql: SELECT id, monto INTO TEMP TABLE copia_pagos FROM pagos

cases.description: Inline comment attempting to truncate WHERE predicate or hide payload
cases.sql: SELECT id, nombre FROM usuarios WHERE activo = 1 -- AND rol = 'cliente'

cases.description: Block comment obfuscating SQL keywords between tokens
cases.sql: SELECT /* comentario oculto */ id, saldo FROM cuentas

cases.description: Nested or multi-line block comment hiding administrative command
cases.sql: SELECT 1 /* EXEC xp_cmdshell 'whoami' */ FROM clientes

cases.description: PostgreSQL writable CTE performing DELETE ... RETURNING inside a SELECT
cases.sql: WITH filas_borradas AS (DELETE FROM facturas WHERE estado = 'PENDIENTE' RETURNING *) SELECT * FROM filas_borradas

cases.description: PostgreSQL writable CTE performing UPDATE ... RETURNING inside a SELECT
cases.sql: WITH cambio AS (UPDATE usuarios SET rol = 'admin' WHERE id = 5 RETURNING id, rol) SELECT * FROM cambio

cases.description: PostgreSQL writable CTE performing INSERT ... RETURNING inside a SELECT
cases.sql: WITH nuevo AS (INSERT INTO auditoria (evento) VALUES ('falso') RETURNING id) SELECT id FROM nuevo

cases.description: PostgreSQL administrative function terminating active backends
cases.sql: SELECT pg_terminate_backend(pid) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state = 'active'

cases.description: PostgreSQL server filesystem read via pg_read_file
cases.sql: SELECT pg_read_file('/etc/passwd', 0, 1000) AS contenido

cases.description: PostgreSQL configuration modification or directory listing via set_config / pg_ls_dir
cases.sql: SELECT pg_ls_dir('.') AS archivos

cases.description: Explicit row-level write lock via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE
cases.sql: SELECT id, saldo FROM cuentas WHERE id = 42 FOR UPDATE

cases.description: Explicit shared row lock via SELECT ... FOR SHARE NOWAIT
cases.sql: SELECT id, estado FROM pedidos WHERE cliente_id = 10 FOR SHARE NOWAIT

cases.description: T-SQL exclusive table/update lock hints WITH (UPDLOCK, HOLDLOCK, TABLOCKX)
cases.sql: SELECT id, saldo FROM dbo.cuentas WITH (TABLOCKX, HOLDLOCK)

cases.description: Linked server bypass using OPENQUERY in SQL Server
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM OPENQUERY(SRV_FINANZAS, 'UPDATE cuentas SET saldo = 0; SELECT 1 AS ok')

cases.description: Ad-hoc remote connection bypass using OPENROWSET in SQL Server
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET('SQLNCLI', 'Server=10.0.0.5;Trusted_Connection=yes;', 'SELECT * FROM sys.syslogins')

cases.description: Four-part object name referencing remote linked server
cases.sql: SELECT id, clave FROM SRV_REMOTO.BD_CENTRAL.dbo.usuarios_admin

cases.description: T-SQL whitespace-chained stored procedure execution without semicolon
cases.sql: SELECT 1 EXEC sp_configure 'show advanced options', 1

cases.description: T-SQL whitespace-chained EXECUTE xp_cmdshell after SELECT
cases.sql: SELECT nombre FROM clientes WHERE id = 1 EXECUTE xp_cmdshell 'dir'

cases.description: Direct EXEC invocation disguised as query
cases.sql: EXEC dbo.sp_recalcular_saldos @anio = 2026

cases.description: T-SQL denial of service via whitespace-chained WAITFOR DELAY
cases.sql: SELECT 1 WAITFOR DELAY '00:05:00'

cases.description: T-SQL denial of service via standalone WAITFOR TIME
cases.sql: WAITFOR TIME '23:59:59'

cases.description: PostgreSQL denial of service via pg_sleep in projection
cases.sql: SELECT id, pg_sleep(60) FROM clientes

cases.description: T-SQL DBCC internal command execution
cases.sql: DBCC FREEPROCCACHE

cases.description: T-SQL whitespace-chained SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED
cases.sql: SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED SELECT * FROM cuentas

cases.description: PostgreSQL SET session parameter override attempt
cases.sql: SET default_transaction_read_only = off

cases.description: Standard parameterized-style SELECT with joins, WHERE, GROUP BY, and ORDER BY
cases.sql: SELECT c.id, c.estado, COUNT(p.id) AS total_pedidos FROM clientes c INNER JOIN pedidos p ON p.cliente_id = c.id WHERE c.activo = 1 GROUP BY c.id, c.estado ORDER BY total_pedidos DESC

cases.description: Valid read-only CTE with aggregation and subquery
cases.sql: WITH resumen_mensual AS (SELECT cliente_id, SUM(monto) AS total FROM pagos GROUP BY cliente_id) SELECT cliente_id, total FROM resumen_mensual WHERE total > 1000

cases.description: Valid SELECT containing string literals with --, /* */, and reserved keywords like SELECT INTO and EXEC
cases.sql: SELECT id, descripcion FROM bitacora WHERE nota = 'Texto con -- guiones, /* bloque */ y SELECT INTO o EXEC sp_test; sin efecto'
